sentences.text: Ms M. H. Deshmukh, Addl. P. P. for the Non-Applicant No.1/State.
Coram : Vinay Joshi And Valmiki Sa Menezes, Jj.

The Applicant - mother-in-law is seeking to quash the First Information Report (Fir) in Crime
No.69 of 2022, registered with Nandgao Peth Police Station, District Amravati, for the offences
punishable under Sections 498A, 354A, 313, 506(2) and 504 read with Section 34 of the Indian
Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 and related charge-sheet.
3.  The informant lady has lodged a report making several allegations consisting matrimonial harassment against her husband and other family members.
The Police have completed investigation and filed a charge-sheet.

4. It is the Applicant's case that she is residing at Village Pandhurna, District Chhindwara, (M.P.)
and thus she has no occasion to reside in shared household with the informant.
It is submitted that the entire allegations are vague and falsely levelled to pressurize the husband.
Issue notice for final disposal to the Non-Applicants, returnable 10.03.2023.
